planets.name: WASP-166 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-166 with a 5.44-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: WASP-166 b was found in 2019 by WASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-166. Its orbit and size follow Hellier et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname HELLIER_ET_AL__2019): disc_year 2019, disc_facility WASP-South, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 5.4435354, pl_radj 0.63, pl_bmassj 0.101
